title: Feature request: inform about empty translation in tabs (`TabbedTranslationAdmin`)
author: adi-
body_preview: I think it would be very helpful if `TabbedTranslationAdmin` visually indicated when a translation is missing in one of the language tabs. For example, the tab could display an icon, a star or other similar text sign, a colored border, or different styling to let users immediately see which translations still need to be completed.

title: COPY does not work properly on GeoStories, Dashboards, and remote datasets
author: sijandh35
body_preview: ## Description  The resource COPY flow creates the cloned resource, but some type-specific content is not preserved.  For geostory and dashboard resources, the clone is created successfully, but the cloned app opens empty because the GeoApp blob content is cleared during the copy flow.  For remote datasets, the clone can miss the URL-only data link used to access the remote source.

title: [API v3] Bootstrap the /api/v3/ entry point
author: etj
body_preview: ### Why  Every v3 resource needs the same router, pagination, and field-selection mechanism.  Building that once first keeps the resource issues small.  ### What  - The `/api/v3/` router and URL wiring. - Shared base pieces: bounded pagination, a base viewset, the `?fields=`  mechanism, and the explicit-permissions requirement. - No resource endpoints in this issue.

title: Design API v3
